message.text: I need to explore the repository structure to find where the store layer handles memo deletion logic.

I'm checking whether the driver-level DeleteMemo in the store layer also cleans up related records like memo_organizer or memo_share, so I want to look at the sqlite implementation for details.Ripgrep isn't available here, so I'll fall back to reading the file directly or using shell grep instead.

I'm checking whether other related tables like memo_organizer, reaction, or memo_share get cleaned up through cascading deletes or triggers, versus explicit deletion logic in the store layer. I want to confirm what memo.go actually handles versus what might rely on foreign key cascades, and see if memo_service.go's router layer does any additional deletion work.

The answer centers on the store's DeleteMemo function: it explicitly removes memo_relation records in both directions (as memo_id and related_memo_id) and attachment records, before the memo row itself is deleted. I'll cite this from store/memo.go, focusing on the store layer as the question specifies rather than any router-level cleanup.
